decision_sources.name: Define the Order record and lifecycle contract
Define Vendor identity and historical semantics
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries

scenarios.name: unmanaged root
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: The root has no .spielorders directory.

scenarios.name: healthy package and healthy order
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
scenarios.condition: All required version-1 artifacts are present and the Order has opaque Supporting Material.

scenarios.name: damaged package missing canonical root artifact
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: vendors.json is absent while .spielorders exists.

scenarios.name: damaged order malformed canonical record
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: One Order has malformed JSON while the Package root remains healthy.

scenarios.name: ignored hidden direct children
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
scenarios.condition: Hidden file, directory, and link entries occur directly under the Orders Directory.

scenarios.name: warned direct-child file and link
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: Visible non-directory entries occur directly under the Orders Directory.

scenarios.name: unexpected reserved Order content
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: An unrecognized file appears in an Order's reserved .spielorders directory.

scenarios.name: README absence
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
scenarios.condition: Package and Order README files are absent.

scenarios.name: README unreadable
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: An Order README exists but cannot be read as UTF-8.

scenarios.name: stale derived index
sources: Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: The valid index projection does not match current canonical facts.

scenarios.name: invalid derived index
sources: Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: index.json fails its schema while canonical artifacts remain valid.

scenarios.name: duplicate Order IDs
sources: Define the Order record and lifecycle contract
Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: Two schema-valid Order records contain the same Order ID.
preservation: both Order Directories and Supporting Material

scenarios.name: duplicate Vendor IDs
sources: Define Vendor identity and historical semantics
Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
scenarios.condition: Two individually schema-valid Vendors share one Vendor ID.

scenarios.name: duplicate Vendor Names
sources: Define Vendor identity and historical semantics
Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
scenarios.condition: Vendor Names differ only by surrounding whitespace and case.

scenarios.name: unresolved Vendor Reference
sources: Define Vendor identity and historical semantics
Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
scenarios.condition: A schema-valid Order references a UUID absent from vendors.json.

scenarios.name: directory-name drift
sources: Define the SpielOrders package topology
Define the Order record and lifecycle contract
scenarios.condition: The Order Directory basename differs from the current projection.

scenarios.name: unusual valid numeric Item values
sources: Define the Order record and lifecycle contract
Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
scenarios.condition: An Item uses negative quantity and fractional negative unit price.

scenarios.name: staging artifact
sources: Define integrity, validation, and repair boundaries
Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
scenarios.condition: A beside-destination staging artifact remains after interruption.

scenarios.name: unsupported newer metadata
sources: Define durable metadata schemas and version evolution
scenarios.condition: The Package marker declares a newer unsupported metadata version.

scenarios.name: legacy adoption candidate with ambiguous evidence
sources: Define legacy Order adoption and metadata bootstrapping
Define the SpielOrders package topology
scenarios.condition: An eligible ordinary Order Directory has an ambiguous legacy basename, an existing README, and opaque Supporting Material but no managed metadata.
